Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. We encourage you to explore different content areas or geographies through a year-long rotation with one of our practices (e.g., corporate finance, social sector, healthcare, operations) or global offices.
